poe_night_lines: The moon is up, and the harbor holds its breath.
Fog crawls the cobbles like it lost something.
Somewhere a shutter knocks. Nobody is there.
The streetlamps flicker, counting your steps.
A black bird watches from the rowhouse ledge.
Midnight tastes like rust and cold river air.
Every alley hums a tune you almost remember.
The clock tower skips a beat. So does your heart.
Shadows here stretch longer than they should.
A lantern sways on the pier with no wind at all.
Listen. The bricks are whispering your name.
The water taxi drifts by, its cabin empty.
Night pulls its velvet hood over the city.
Something old is waking beneath the stones.
Dawn is far off. Keep your candle close.
phantom_taunts: Boo! Did that one get you?
You run like a creaky floorboard.
I've haunted faster snails than you.
Catch me? I'm made of fog, friend.
Your lantern won't save you tonight.
I'll be waiting in the next cold spot.
Turn around. No, the other way.
I float. You stumble. Simple math.
My chains rattle louder than your knees.
Ooooh, so close. Not really, though.
See you in the attic, slowpoke.
brewmaster_finale_lines: So, you reached the cellar. I saw you coming.
One eye is all I need to watch you fail.
Welcome to my brewhouse. Mind the boiling vats.
Phase one: let's see how you handle the steam!
You dodge well. Let's turn up the heat.
Phase two: the floor is foam now. Enjoy.
My eye sees every move before you make it!
Hops, malt and fury, all in one big kettle!
Phase three: I'm uncorking the big one!
Impossible! Nobody gets past the copper still!
My eye is watering. It's the steam, I swear!
Fine. You've bested the Brewmaster. This time.
The vats go quiet. The cellar is yours.
Take my apron. You've earned the brewhouse keys.
fishing_chompy_lines: Got one! A shiny little perch!
Nice catch! That one's a keeper.
Whoa, a big one! Hold steady!
Rare catch! The tackle shop will gasp.
It slipped the hook. So close!
Too slow! The fish swam off laughing.
Line snagged on a pier post. Oops.
Chompy snapped the line clean off!
Chompy burps. That was your fish.
Reel fast before Chompy comes back!
credits_thanks: Made with love and too much coffee.
Thanks to every playtester out there.
No ghosts were harmed in this game.
You made the city shine brighter.
See you on the next adventure!
final_clear_messages: Game cleared! You're a city legend!
Every boss beaten. Take a bow!
The night is over. The city is safe.
You did it! Brag to your friends.
New Game+ unlocked. Ready for more?
